sec.title: Introduction
sec.p: Base editors convert one base into another without a double strand break, which makes them attractive for correcting point mutations in living cells.
Their accuracy is limited by activity on bases other than the intended one.

sec.title: Results
sec.p: We observed that off-target editing arose chiefly from deaminase activity on transiently exposed single stranded DNA rather than from guide mismatches.

sec.title: Editing window
sec.p: Within the editing window every cytosine was converted, so bystander edits accumulated at sites adjacent to the target base in most experiments we ran.
